<thought>We need to retrieve polymorphs for a set of sulphide compositions (max 40) with energy above hull ≤0.3 eV/atom and at most 3 polymorphs per composition. We'll use the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool, then list the generated files, map each composition to its JSON file, and finally consolidate everything into a single JSON dataset. The final answer should be the path to the consolidated file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
